_comment: Followers of external Discord signal channels. Following is PER CHANNEL: every caller you follow needs an entry under 'channels', keyed by Discord channel ID, and an unlisted channel is never traded. riskPerTradeUsd = max $ to lose if the stop loss hits. leverage = HL margin leverage. marginMode = 'cross' or 'isolated'. Set enabled=false on a channel to pause all of that caller's entries, or on one follower to pause just that person. Exits still route to every follower listed on the channel, since a reduce-only order can only close exposure that entries already opened.
_rateLimitComment: openRateLimits cap how many positions automation may OPEN, per sliding window, per (channel, follower). Exits are NEVER rate limited. maxOpens=0 pauses a channel's entries without disabling anyone. Channels that omit openRateLimits use defaultOpenRateLimits.
